newsitem.title: USA: Bev-Tyme likely to be delisted by Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Bev-Tyme likely to be delisted by Nasdaq.

text.p: Bev-Tyme Inc said on Thursday it is likely to be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market because the company's balance sheet reflects a shareholders deficit of $265,000.
Nasdaq requires a minimum shareholders equity of $1 million for this listing.
Bev-Tyme said in a news release that it has been advised by Nasdaq that it should be delisted. Bev-Tyme said it will be afforded a hearing, but added that it believes it likely will be delisted.
Bev-Tyme on Thursday reported a first-quarter loss of $0.32 per share, compared to a loss of $0.08 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said that if it is delisted, it expects that its securities will trade on Nasdaq's over-the-counter bulletin board.
Bev-Tyme said it has moved to smaller warehouse and cut its number of trucks and sales staff in a bid to position itself for future growth.
Bev-Tyme distributes beverages, beers and snack items in the New York City metropolitan area.
